sections.voiceover: In 1841, The Murders in the Rue Morgue introduced the amateur detective C. Auguste Dupin. This Parisian apartment mystery established the foundational template for the entire detective fiction genre. How did Arthur Conan Doyle manage to expand this genre decades after Poe's initial success?
